episode_title: 243. SKYLAKE Adventures with Sean Mouse Howard
question: How did Sean Mouse Howard get the nickname Mouse and why does he use it on his business card?
transcript_excerpt: The nickname Mouse originated at Butler University in 1989 during his fraternity pledgeship when a gentleman said he looked like Mickey Mouse. Sean suggested calling him Mouse instead because his mother Michelle goes by Mickey. Years later, while on a medical device business trip in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, a vascular surgeon named Chad Lowrich suggested Sean use the nickname when calling into the catheterization lab because it would be memorable and a good differentiator.

episode_title: 243. SKYLAKE Adventures with Sean Mouse Howard
question: What was Sean Howard's defining moment at Butler University regarding his academic performance?
transcript_excerpt: In January 1989, while in the fraternity house watching The Price is Right, his mother came downstairs and grabbed him by the ear after receiving his poor report card. She pulled him aside and told him he was on scholarship and if he did not take his studies seriously, she would yank him out of school and make him go back home to Princeton. Sean describes this as a fork in the road moment that made him take his education seriously at one of the finest universities in the country.

episode_title: 243. SKYLAKE Adventures with Sean Mouse Howard
question: What injury did Sean Howard suffer during his high school football career and how did it affect his scholarship prospects?
transcript_excerpt: During football practice in 1986, going into his sophomore year, Sean tackled and tore his ACL. Back then, medical treatment involved a full leg cast for six weeks, which caused severe atrophy. When the cast was removed, his leg was the size of his arm. He had to work extremely hard to recover because track was his escape route out of Princeton, Indiana, and he had been receiving collegiate letters for track as a freshman.

episode_title: 243. SKYLAKE Adventures with Sean Mouse Howard
question: Why did Sean Howard choose Butler University over other schools that recruited him for track?
transcript_excerpt: After Sean tore his ACL, the recruiting letters stopped. However, Bill Niederhaus, a track coach who still works at Butler, advocated for him to Coach Stan Lyons, saying Sean would put everything on the line and be great for the team. At the end of July, Coach Lyons called Sean's house offering a partial scholarship after one of their runners left. Sean accepted immediately without ever having visited the campus beyond an orientation two weeks before.

episode_title: 243. SKYLAKE Adventures with Sean Mouse Howard
question: How did Sean Howard transition from accounting to business at Butler University?
transcript_excerpt: During his junior year in fall, when big accounting firms came to pitch careers, Sean asked a recruiter about a day in the life. The recruiter described sitting in a cubicle looking at a computer crunching numbers all day. Sean decided immediately that was not for him and switched majors, calling his mom from the fraternity house pay phone. His mother told him she did not care what he studied, but he had to finish on time or he was done. Senior year, Sean took 21 to 24 hours per semester to graduate on schedule.
